model.input: title + newline + description for each record
model.account_pooling: L2-normalize each item embedding, mean all records with multiplicity, L2-normalize account mean
model.pair_input: concatenate absolute difference and elementwise product

schedule: One group=378 BCE edges=one update. Sort group_uid then shuffle each epoch using one Python Random per training segment. Single/sequential seeds seed_for(initialization_seed,order,stage,current); joint seed_for(initialization_seed,JOINT,1,current). Joint shuffles all 180 train groups together each epoch.
loss: mean unweighted BCE on one current full group; no replay
execution_boundary: Proposed resource ceilings pending reported Linux stage resumption; no connection authorized by this file. Training parses new train binary CSV once; complete-gated Windows evaluation parses valid once; no heldout/owners/old assets.
